title: Junior Madi Russ makes her mark through leadership, service and school spirit
summary_en: Junior Madi Russ has kept a busy schedule during her time at IU: studying elementary education, competing as an athlete with IU Rowing, and even starting new student organizations, all part of how she’s making the most of her time on campus.
